Rosa Barks is the pet poodle of the Hibbert family. Her name is an obvious play on the famous civil rights activist , probably because of the fact that Dr. Hibbert and his family are of African-American descent.

page.overview:
Who is Rosa Barks?

Rosa Barks is the pet poodle of the Hibbert family. Her name is an obvious play on the famous civil rights activist , probably because of the fact that Dr. Hibbert and his family are of African-American descent.

Santa's Little Helper mated with Rosa Barks, and sired a litter of puppies, which Dr. Hibbert pawned to the Simpsons family. Bart and Lisa give the puppies to various townspeople, including Krusty the Clown, Snake Jailbird, Groundskeeper Willie and Mr. Burns.
